Senses.Explanation: A four-graph unit naming the full display of asking and answering, granted by the masters and flipped the moment it is granted. Asked by an official what he deploys since the old worthies transmitted mind to mind, Yunmen Wenyan answers with the unit itself — asking and answering both present — and when the official presses that the deployment is not empty, flips it: no asking, no answering; Linji Yixuan lists it as the last of his four deployings, where asking-and-answering with guest and host established, kneading water and mud, meets the moment; Yuanwu Keqin traces the wealth of devices — weighted and real, shining and working, killing and quickening, guest and host, asking and answering — to the many aims and depths of the group; and Dahui Zonggao opens his address with the doubled strings, asking-and-answering, releasing-and-gathering, host and guest, killing and quickening, each holding to its own rule. Yuejiang Zhengyin, weighing the root case, stages the asking for himself at Ayuwang and answers only: guest and host standing out — sparing the monk his running south and north; Gulin Qingmao stages it for the mountain monk and answers with drawing one and adding three, the angry Fan Kuai before the founder's hall; Yu'an Zhiji, ruling Changqing and Muzhou never met the exchange-free half, stages it for Jingzan and answers with a song the green hill sings alone, a feeling the white clouds never know; and Yezhu Fuhui pairs it with the slippery stone road and the coming eighth day, warning that either way one turns to boxwood dullness or plank-carrying blindness, his surpassing phrase beaten out in three drum taps on the cold cliff and five watches on the broken temple's bell.
